# Jessup Manufacturing

> > Jessup Manufacturing produces safety and graphics solutions including UL 924-certified Glo Brite photoluminescent egress marking, NFSI and NAVSEA-approved Safety Track anti-slip tapes, and specialized graphics media for commercial, military, and transit applications.

Jessup Manufacturing is a leading manufacturer of safety products and graphics media, serving industries from fire safety and building egress to military marine applications and skateboarding. Their product lines meet rigorous certifications including UL 924, NFSI, MIL-PRF-24667C, and US Coast Guard approvals.

## Key Topics

- Glo Brite photoluminescent egress marking
- Safety Track anti-slip tapes
- UL 924 fire safety certification
- NFSI slip resistance certification
- NAVSEA military-grade approval
- MIL-PRF-24667C military specification
- Photoluminescent film technology
- Exit signs and egress marking
- Floor graphics media
- Transit graphics solutions
- Technical data sheets (TDS)
- Safety data sheets (SDS)
- Anti-slip grit tapes and treads
- Fire safety applications
- Building safety solutions

## Core Products

- [Products We Make](https://www.jessupmfg.com/products-we-make.html): Product catalog featuring Glo Brite UL924-certified fire safety signs
- [Photoluminescent Tapes & Signs - Fire Safety](https://www.jessupmfg.com/products-solutions/photoluminescent-sign-tapes/applications/fire-safety.html): Glo Brite photoluminescent egress marking for fire safety applications
- [80 Grit Anti-Slip Tapes & Treads](https://www.jessupmfg.com/products-solutions/anti-slip-tapes-treads/grit/80-grit-fine.html): 80-grit Safety Track anti-slip tapes in commercial and military grades
- [Military Grade Black Anti-Skid Grit Tape 6" x 24" Treads](https://www.jessupmfg.com/safety-trackr-military-grade-black-anti-skid-grit-6-x-24-treads-25-cs.html): NAVSEA-approved MIL-PRF-24667C military-grade 6"x24" anti-skid treads
- [Jessup Griptape](https://www.jessupmfg.com/jessup-griptape): Skateboard griptape lineup: ULTRAGRIP, The Original, NBD, NIKE Grind

## Graphics Media Solutions

- [Transit Graphics Media](https://www.jessupmfg.com/products-solutions/graphics-media/applications/transit.html): Transit graphics media including Glo Brite, CatWalk, and Print n' Go
- [TexWalk Textured Vinyl Graphics Media](https://www.jessupmfg.com/products-solutions/graphics-media/textured-vinyl/sportwalkr-1.html): TexWalk textured vinyl graphics media for floor and wall applications
